newsitem.title: LATVIA: PM SHKELE NOT PLANNING TO QUIT - SPOKESMAN.
newsitem.headline: PM SHKELE NOT PLANNING TO QUIT - SPOKESMAN.

text.p: Prime Minister Andris Shkele is not planning to resign amid a controversy over a corruption scandal that has overshadowed the Latvian government and establishment, his spokesman said on Tuesday.
The scandal blew up after allegations that members of parliament and government ministers violated anti-corruption laws by being company directors while they held official posts.
Shkele is due to make a speech on television at 2100/1800 GMT to give his comments on the political situation in the country amid rumours that he may step down.
Asked if Shkele would resign, his spokesman said: "He will not".
So far, only Culture Minister Rihard Piks has resigned over the anti-corruption row.
